So effectively 2 useful moves + 1 wasted. Then 16 more = 18 useful + 1 wasted = 19 total. That matches the ~19 target! So the human baseline is probably 18-19 moves, and I'm right on track (I'll use 9+16=25, but 1 of the 9 was a no-op, so 24 "real" + ... hmm).
Actually, let me not overthink. The point is: the 16-move path from (2,2) is the optimal continuation (BFS shortest path). Executing it is the right move. Let me do it.
Let me execute the full 16-move batch with intent='solve'.
Actually, let me reconsider whether to batch all 16 or do it in chunks. Batching all 16 is most efficient (one tool call). If the level completes mid-batch (it shouldn't, since T is only reached at the end), the game would handle it. Let me batch all 16.
